references.title: Inheritance and super()
references.summary: Official Python documentation for class inheritance and super().
references.syntax:
class Animal:
    def __init__(self, name):
        self.name = name
    def speak(self):
        return '...'

class Dog(Animal):           # Dog наследует Animal
    def __init__(self, name, breed):
        super().__init__(name)  # вызов __init__ родителя
        self.breed = breed
    def speak(self):             # переопределение метода
        return 'Woof!'

d = Dog('Rex', 'Husky')
print(d.name)   # Rex  (из Animal)
print(d.speak())  # Woof!

references.title: __slots__
references.summary: Official Python documentation for __slots__ — restricts attributes and reduces memory usage.
references.syntax:
class Point:
    __slots__ = ('x', 'y')  # только эти атрибуты разрешены
    def __init__(self, x, y):
        self.x = x
        self.y = y

p = Point(1, 2)
# p.z = 3  # AttributeError: slots prevent this
